tools.name: query
tools.title: Query LiveNotebook data
tools.description: Read data from the signed-in teacher's LiveNotebook CRM. Never writes. Pick one operation in "request.resource": students.list, students.get, schedule_slots.list, schedule_slots.get, lessons.list, lessons.get, lessons.today, attendance.list, finance.list, finance.debts, finance.unpaid_students, homework.list, homework.get, homework.upcoming, settings.get, reports.period_summary, trash.list, students.search, students.summary, schedule.week, schedule.free_slots, schedule.conflicts, lessons.stats, attendance.stats, finance.period_summary, finance.student_balance, homework.stats, dashboard.summary, reports.student_summary, search.global, trash.get. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, times HH:MM, weekdays 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Date ranges may not exceed one year.

tools.name: mutate
tools.title: Change LiveNotebook data
tools.description: Create or change one record in the signed-in teacher's LiveNotebook CRM. Pick one operation in "request.operation": student.create, student.update, student.set_status, schedule_slot.create, schedule_slot.update, schedule_slot.move, lesson.create, lesson.move, lesson.update, lesson.set_status, attendance.mark, finance.create, finance.update, finance.set_paid, homework.create, homework.update, settings.update, record.soft_delete, record.restore, record.prepare_permanent_delete, record.confirm_permanent_delete, students.bulk_update_status, attendance.bulk_mark, finance.bulk_set_paid, lessons.bulk_set_status, lessons.bulk_move, homework.bulk_update_status. Deletion is soft by default ("record.soft_delete") and reversible with "record.restore". Permanent deletion is two-step: "record.prepare_permanent_delete" returns a token, then "record.confirm_permanent_delete" consumes it — only after the user explicitly confirms. Attendance marking is idempotent per student and date.

tools.name: workflow
tools.title: Run a LiveNotebook workflow
tools.description: Run one supported multi-step routine in the signed-in teacher's LiveNotebook CRM. Pick one in "request.workflow": onboard_student, complete_lesson, reschedule_lesson, record_payment, archive_student, request_permanent_delete, schedule.reschedule_day, student.full_profile, finance.reconcile_student. Each call returns a per-step report. Every workflow is reversible: none performs permanent deletion — "request_permanent_delete" only returns a confirmation token, and the user must confirm before the "mutate" tool executes "record.confirm_permanent_delete".

workflow.description: Create a student and, optionally, their recurring weekly slots in one reversible sequence.

anyOf.description: Create a student and, optionally, their recurring weekly slots in one reversible sequence.

workflow.description: Close out a lesson: set its status to completed, mark attendance, and optionally assign homework.

anyOf.description: Close out a lesson: set its status to completed, mark attendance, and optionally assign homework.

workflow.description: Move a lesson to a new date/time and optionally record that the teacher rescheduled it in attendance.

anyOf.description: Move a lesson to a new date/time and optionally record that the teacher rescheduled it in attendance.

workflow.description: Record money received: either mark existing unpaid records paid, or create a new paid entry.

anyOf.description: Record money received: either mark existing unpaid records paid, or create a new paid entry.

workflow.description: Archive a student: set status to archived, trash their weekly slots, and trash today's and future planned/moved lessons. Fully reversible from trash; history is untouched.

anyOf.description: Archive a student: set status to archived, trash their weekly slots, and trash today's and future planned/moved lessons. Fully reversible from trash; history is untouched.

workflow.description: Prepare an irreversible deletion: returns a confirmation token only. This workflow NEVER deletes; the user must confirm and then mutate/record.confirm_permanent_delete is called.

anyOf.description: Prepare an irreversible deletion: returns a confirmation token only. This workflow NEVER deletes; the user must confirm and then mutate/record.confirm_permanent_delete is called.

workflow.description: Move all matching lessons from one day to another (optionally shifting the time). Without confirm=true it only previews the plan and conflicts; nothing is written.

anyOf.description: Move all matching lessons from one day to another (optionally shifting the time). Without confirm=true it only previews the plan and conflicts; nothing is written.

workflow.description: Read-only bundle for one student: profile, weekly slots, upcoming lessons, attendance stats, unpaid finance and open homework.

anyOf.description: Read-only bundle for one student: profile, weekly slots, upcoming lessons, attendance stats, unpaid finance and open homework.

workflow.description: Preview only: match a proposed payment against a student's unpaid records and suggest which ones it would cover. Never marks anything paid and never deletes.

anyOf.description: Preview only: match a proposed payment against a student's unpaid records and suggest which ones it would cover. Never marks anything paid and never deletes.
